title: A chess club practice session
passage: Welcome to chess practice. Beginners, use the boards by the front window; a member will show you how the pieces move. The middle tables are for short games if you know the rules. We aren't keeping score today, so leave the scorebooks on the shelf. The picture in each case shows where to put the pieces away. Practice ends at half past four; the shop closes at five.
passageZh: 歡迎來練習西洋棋。初學者請使用前面窗邊的棋盤；社員會教你棋子怎麼走。懂規則的人可在中間的桌子下短局。今天不記分，請把記分簿留在架上。每個盒子內的圖會告訴你棋子應放回哪裡。練習四點半結束；商店五點打烊。
